name: cz.gelato/eshop
title: GELATO.cz
description: Gelato and pastry ingredients for professionals (CZ, B2B): catalog, cart and orders.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the e-shop catalog by product name or EAN code. Public — no authentication needed. Every product carries the EAN, brand, pack size with its unit (kg for goods sold by weight, ks for goods sold by the piece) and the resulting price_per_unit, plus weight_kg. Prices are EXCLUDING VAT — price_vat_included is false and vat_rate gives the rate in percent. The exact stock quantity is returned only to authenticated customers; anonymous callers get in_stock as a yes/no. Authenticated customers get prices that include their personal discount.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full detail of one product: description, annotation, URL and everything the listing tools return. Public — no authentication needed. Every product carries the EAN, brand, pack size with its unit (kg for goods sold by weight, ks for goods sold by the piece) and the resulting price_per_unit, plus weight_kg. Prices are EXCLUDING VAT — price_vat_included is false and vat_rate gives the rate in percent. The exact stock quantity is returned only to authenticated customers; anonymous callers get in_stock as a yes/no.

product_id.description: Product id (product_id) from search_products or list_category_products

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Full catalog category tree of the e-shop (ice-cream and pastry catalogs): names, absolute URLs and product counts per category. The best starting point for browsing the assortment structurally. Public — no authentication needed.

include_counts.description: Include product_count per category, default true

tools.name: list_category_products
tools.description: Paged list of products in one catalog category, by category id or URL slug (see list_categories). Public — no authentication needed. Every product carries the EAN, brand, pack size with its unit (kg for goods sold by weight, ks for goods sold by the piece) and the resulting price_per_unit, plus weight_kg. Prices are EXCLUDING VAT — price_vat_included is false and vat_rate gives the rate in percent. The exact stock quantity is returned only to authenticated customers; anonymous callers get in_stock as a yes/no. Authenticated customers get prices that include their personal discount.

category_id.description: Category id from list_categories; give either category_id or slug

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Current content of the customer's shopping cart with totals, transport cost and any system notes.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a quantity of a product to the cart (whole units, as in the web shop). Quantity is added to what is already in the cart. Products sold by whole cartons are rounded up to full cartons automatically.

product_id.description: Product id (product_id) from search_products or list_category_products

quantity.description: Number of packs to add (whole units of the product as sold, not kg)

tools.name: update_cart_item
tools.description: Set the absolute quantity of a product in the cart. Quantity 0 removes the product.

product_id.description: Product id of an item already in the cart (see get_cart)

quantity.description: New total number of packs in the cart; 0 removes the product

tools.name: clear_cart
tools.description: Remove all items from the shopping cart.

tools.name: create_delivery_address
tools.description: Create a delivery address (place of business) for this customer — required once before the first order, exactly as the web shop asks right after registration. Minimum: city, zip, house number, a contact surname and a phone for the carrier; street may be empty in villages without street names. Leave the address fields empty to deliver to the registered company address from ARES (city, zip, street and house number are then copied from the account). Input is tidied automatically (phone prefix, zip spacing); only what cannot be fixed is refused. Payment terms of the address follow the customer account; the payment of a particular order is chosen in place_order. Returns delivery_address_id for checkout_preview and place_order.

street.description: Street name without the house number; may be empty in villages without street names

place_name.description: Name of the shop / production site, defaults to the company name

contact_first_name.description: First name of the person receiving the goods, optional

contact_surname.description: Who receives the goods — printed for the carrier

email.description: E-mail of the delivery place only when it differs from the account e-mail

delivery_method_id.description: Default transport for this address; TOPTRANS courier when omitted

tools.name: list_delivery_addresses
tools.description: Delivery addresses registered for this customer. Use the returned id as delivery_address_id in place_order when the customer has more than one. A brand-new customer has none yet — call create_delivery_address first.

tools.name: checkout_preview
tools.description: Preview the order before placing it: final items, totals including VAT and transport, delivery address and payment/delivery methods. Always call this before place_order.

delivery_address_id.description: Delivery address id from list_delivery_addresses; the default address when omitted

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place a REAL, BINDING order from the current cart on behalf of the customer. Requires confirm=true. The customer receives the standard order confirmation email.

confirm.description: Must be true. Only set after the customer approved the checkout preview.

delivery_address_id.description: Delivery address id from list_delivery_addresses; the default address when omitted

delivery_method_id.description: Transport: 2 = Post, 3 = Delivery by account manager, 4 = Train, 5 = Personal pickup, 6 = TOPTRANS courier, 7 = Pickup at TOPTRANS depot; the address default when omitted

payment_method_id.description: Payment: 1 = Bank transfer, 2 = Cash, 3 = Cash on delivery; the address default when omitted

tools.name: list_my_orders
tools.description: Recent orders of this customer with their status.

tools.name: get_my_order
tools.description: Detail of one order of this customer, including its items and status.

order_id.description: Order id from list_my_orders or place_order
